endpoints.native: CPU fractal traversal plus colored raster; setup/reset excluded; native timings captured during preparation.
endpoints.original: Pinned JS traversal plus Canvas2D strokes; submit and full RGBA readback endpoints.
endpoints.wasm: advance(1_000_000) loop through complete(); setup/reset excluded; raster view access and Canvas2D presentation measured separately.
endpoints.presentation: Cached ImageData.data.set+putImageData vs MoxiRasterPresenter; same source bytes, fresh typed views, alternating path order, 1px synchronization on both paths.
endpoints.visibility: Canvas submission and synchronous readback only; screen display, compositing and input latency are not measured.

64.note: Per-call advance timing includes JS/Wasm boundary and two clock reads; excludes event scheduling and input dispatch.

2048.note: Per-call advance timing includes JS/Wasm boundary and two clock reads; excludes event scheduling and input dispatch.
